# Campfire: a ring of seven stones (r 0.42), three logs leaning into a teepee, a glowing ember bed,
# a flame base and three flame tongues. Stones and logs are lit; embers and flames are emissive
# (unlit splats). Each tongue is its own object (one bone): stepped scale and sway keys on a 1 s loop
# (12 frames, constant), following the intensity table I = [2, 1, 1, 0, 1, 2, 1, 2, 0, 1, 2, 1] (frame 0 = a flare: the
# largest pose, which the bake samples). Generated by make_campfire.py. Up Z; origin = the fire's
# centre on the ground.
new
fps 12
frame range 0 12
material new Stone --base-color 0.5490 0.4863 0.4745 --no-slot
material new Log --base-color 0.5176 0.4275 0.3490 --no-slot
material new Embers --base-color 0.6118 0.3216 0.3059 --emission 0.6118 0.3216 0.3059 --no-slot
material new FlameBase --base-color 0.7255 0.4784 0.3765 --emission 0.7255 0.4784 0.3765 --no-slot
material new FlameCore --base-color 0.8667 0.8118 0.6000 --emission 0.8667 0.8118 0.6000 --no-slot
material new FlameOuter --base-color 0.8000 0.6588 0.4824 --emission 0.8000 0.6588 0.4824 --no-slot
add mesh ico-sphere --name Stone0 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.12 --location 0.404 -0.030 0.06
scale 1.10 0.93 0.7
apply --scale
add mesh ico-sphere --name Stone1 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.12 --location 0.300 0.294 0.06
scale 1.23 1.06 0.7
apply --scale
add mesh ico-sphere --name Stone2 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.12 --location -0.121 0.393 0.06
scale 1.13 0.96 0.7
apply --scale
add mesh ico-sphere --name Stone3 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.12 --location -0.348 0.208 0.06
scale 1.05 1.09 0.7
apply --scale
add mesh ico-sphere --name Stone4 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.12 --location -0.378 -0.227 0.06
scale 1.20 0.94 0.7
apply --scale
add mesh ico-sphere --name Stone5 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.12 --location -0.118 -0.415 0.06
scale 1.18 1.07 0.7
apply --scale
add mesh ico-sphere --name Stone6 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.12 --location 0.284 -0.288 0.06
scale 1.15 1.03 0.7
apply --scale
select Stone0 Stone1 Stone2 Stone3 Stone4 Stone5 Stone6
active Stone0
join
rename Stone0 Stones
material assign Stone
mode edit
select all
randomize --amount 0.02 --seed 5
mode object
add mesh cylinder --name Log0 --vertices 6 --radius 0.075 --depth 0.62 --location 0 0 0 --rotation 0 90 0
apply --rotation
set rotation 0 -40 200
apply --rotation
set location 0.113 0.041 0.2
apply --location
add mesh cylinder --name Log1 --vertices 6 --radius 0.075 --depth 0.62 --location 0 0 0 --rotation 0 90 0
apply --rotation
set rotation 0 -40 320
apply --rotation
set location -0.092 0.077 0.2
apply --location
add mesh cylinder --name Log2 --vertices 6 --radius 0.075 --depth 0.62 --location 0 0 0 --rotation 0 90 0
apply --rotation
set rotation 0 -40 440
apply --rotation
set location -0.021 -0.118 0.2
apply --location
select Log0 Log1 Log2
active Log0
join
rename Log0 Logs
material assign Log
add mesh cylinder --name Embers --vertices 8 --radius 0.27 --depth 0.06 --location 0 0 0.03
material assign Embers
add mesh cone --name FlameBase --vertices 7 --radius1 0.25 --radius2 0.05 --depth 0.44 --location 0 0 0.25
material assign FlameBase
add mesh cone --name TongueA --vertices 6 --radius1 0.13 --radius2 0.01 --depth 0.85 --location 0.0 0.0 0.505
material assign FlameCore
cursor set 0.0 0.0 0.08
origin set --to cursor
add mesh cone --name TongueB --vertices 6 --radius1 0.12 --radius2 0.01 --depth 0.68 --location 0.1 0.07 0.420
material assign FlameOuter
cursor set 0.1 0.07 0.08
origin set --to cursor
add mesh cone --name TongueC --vertices 6 --radius1 0.12 --radius2 0.01 --depth 0.6 --location -0.1 -0.06 0.380
material assign FlameOuter
cursor set -0.1 -0.06 0.08
origin set --to cursor
select TongueA
frame set 0
set location 0.000 0.000 0.08
set scale 1.00 1.00 1.00
keyframe insert --channels loc,scale

set location 0.016 0.024 0.08
set scale 0.95 0.95 0.77

set scale 0.95 0.95 0.68

set scale 0.90 0.90 0.86

set scale 0.94 0.94 0.70
